scripts.test-realistic: docker compose -f tests/compose.yaml run --rm tests sh -c "composer install --no-interaction --quiet && php -d memory_limit=2G vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite realistic"
scripts.benchmark: docker compose -f tests/compose.yaml run --rm tests sh -c "composer install --no-interaction --quiet && php -d memory_limit=2G vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite benchmark"
